lib/test/lint-shipped-pruned-path.py; echo "lint-rc=$?"

git grep -nE "(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_.-])docs/internal/($ALT)" -- skills/ agents/ || echo "(empty-OK)"
echo "=== any docs/internal reference at all in skills/agents (context) ==="
git grep -n 'docs/internal/' -- skills/ agents/ | head -40  …[per-command-truncated]

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; git ls-files docs/internal/ | xargs -n1 basename | paste -sd'|' | tee .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/local-run/alt.txt | head -c 400; echo; echo "count=$(git ls-files docs/internal/ | wc -l)"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow; git ls-files docs/internal/ | xargs -n1 basename | paste -sd'|' > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/local-run/alt.txt; wc -c .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1301/local-run/alt.txt; git ls-files docs/internal/ | wc -l

for f in README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md; do grep -oE 'docs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(md|png|txt)' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | while read -r p; do if [ -e "$p" ]; then echo "OK   $f -> $p"; else echo "MISS $f -> $p"; fi; done; done

grep -nE 'docs/' .gitignore

for f in README.md CONTRIBUTING.md SECURITY.md; do grep -oE 'docs/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.(md|png|txt)' "$f" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | while read -r p; do test -e "$p" && echo "OK   $f -> $p" || echo "MISS $f -> $p"; done; done

for p in docs/internal/ship-pr.png docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md docs/internal/cloud-setup.md; do test -e "$p" && echo "OK $p" || echo "MISS $p"; done 2>&1 || ls docs/internal/ship-pr.png docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md docs/internal/cloud-setup.md
